title: Rewrite History after calibration is only done on master, should be done also on followers
symptom: When Rewrite History is enabled, it is only applied on the master, not on followers. Followers see a sudden jump in the curve and wrong tendency arrows after a calibration.
cause: The rewrite history feature is only implemented on the master device and not on followers.
evidence_quote: When Rewrite History in the settings is enabled, this is only applied on the master, who adjusts the curve to the calibration value(s). On the follower this does not happen.
